concerns.text: SC-001 requires validation against a 'manually annotated gold-standard subset'. T009.6 and T009.8 generate synthetic/proxy labels via heuristics. T009.9 (fetch external) is present but lacks a mandatory dependency link ensuring T010 (the validation test) consumes T009.9's output rather than the synthetic proxies. Without a hard dependency or explicit instruction, the implementation may satisfy the task list but fail the success criterion.

FR-006 and SC-003 require a sensitivity analysis on the text-similarity matching threshold using real data linkage. T025.1 generates 'mock moral judgement data' (synthetic). T025 runs matching against this mock data. Consequently, the sensitivity analysis (T043) will validate robustness on synthetic correlations, failing to measure the stability of the real-world data linkage required by the spec.

SC-006 and US-4 require the primary analysis to derive from 'ReaderResponse' data (human participants or validated proxy). T030 attempts to fetch external data but is marked with a revision note indicating it was replaced by a 'local proxy generation task' in one note and 'external data fetch' in another, creating ambiguity. T030.2 generates synthetic 'text_reflection' strings. If T030 fails to fetch real data, the entire dependent variable for US-3 becomes synthetic, violating SC-006.

The spec explicitly defines 'Reader-response data (US-4)' as the source for the dependent variable. Phase 7 introduces 'Cross-Cultural Stylometric Validation' using generated 'text_reflection' text to 'operationalize empathy'. This replaces the required human-response metric with a synthetic linguistic proxy, contradicting the spec's core research question and SC-006. No task exists to validate this stylometric proxy against real human empathy scores.

T002 includes unresolved placeholders '{{claim:c_f9173ef1}}' and '{{claim:c_4f5198c6}}' in requirements.txt. These are not valid Python package names and will cause the environment setup to fail, violating Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility).

T009.9 description states 'No real manual data available for this corpus' in a revision note, yet the task logic attempts to 'Fetch a publicly available... dataset'. This creates a logical contradiction where the task description claims the data doesn't exist while the task logic assumes it does. The task needs clarification on the specific dataset source or removal if no such dataset exists.
